name: printing-press-bundle
description: Install printing-press with every sibling skill, to create a CLI and maintain it after publishing: the ones it invokes at runtime (printing-press-polish, printing-press-score, printing-press-retro, printing-press-publish, printing-press-reprint, printing-press-import, and the internal printing-press-output-review), printing-press-amend for post-publish patches, and agent-report-guard, the hook that keeps its subagents reporting back. Bundles them as dependencies.
